correctness.rationale: For exact deletion of i<j with j-i<=2, adjacent-pair output A_i matches A_(i+1) precisely when x_i=x_(i+2); equivalence classes form path components. A skipped-middle pair D_i contributes a genuinely new output precisely when x_(i+1) differs from both neighbors, and those new D_i outputs are distinct. Their indicator difference is +1 on all-distinct triples, -1 on equal triples, zero otherwise, proving B(x)=n-1+sum d. Ordered-pair transfer gives the all-n enumerator; extrema follow from forbidden equal triples or proper 3-color walks. Stationary two-dependent triple scores have covariance gamma0=(q-1)(3q^2-5q+1)/q^4, gamma1=(q-1)^3/q^4, gamma2=0, giving the finite variance and positive-variance m-dependent CLT. Independent direct enumerations for q=2,3 and n=3..7 confirmed volumes and rational variances.
